author: Seuthy
body:
IGN: seuthyfromboe 
Discord: seuthy#9057
Timezone: EST
Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph): I enjoy the competitive scene and I think that being a part of the team organizing parts of it would be enjoyable, it seems fun to referee matches, instead of just watching the game from a stream. Another thing is that the streams aren't very good quality (some) and watching live matches seems better than watching a stream as well. I've co-streamed matches of previous tournaments and really enjoy it, so being on the referee team full time would be nice
Best time of the week?: In terms of activity, Saturday
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself(Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): I have probably created a reputation for myself by being toxic to most people and a forum troll, and I actually regret it, but I am a mature person when needed. I'm not some "robot" who follows every staff instruction after being promoted and always enjoy poking fun at people lmao. I like competitive Avicus and enjoy scrimming. I'm usually chill around people who don't have a problem with me and who I don't have a problem with.
Anything else?: na
